name: Kentucky veterans: benefits and claims referrals
description: KDVA’s directory matches counties to regional benefits representatives.
next_step: Choose your county for the published representatives. Ask for accredited claims help, benefits screening and appointment options.
constraints: Regional coverage differs from aging districts. Confirm the current assignment.

name: Kentucky state veterans centers
description: State veterans centers offer skilled nursing, rehabilitation and dementia care.
next_step: Use the admissions links to discuss discharge status, Kentucky residence, care needs, availability and payment.
constraints: Admission depends on eligibility and care the center can provide. Confirm costs and coverage with admissions.

name: Kentucky veterans: homelessness prevention
description: State screening and referral help for veterans facing housing loss; qualifying assistance addresses rent and utilities.
next_step: Ask about the current grant application cycle, required documents and housing referrals. For urgent veteran housing help, call the national VA line at 877-424-3838.
constraints: Service, discharge, income, residency and repeat-award limits apply. The page links an FY 2026 application; confirm the current form and funding. This is not a general home-repair grant.

name: Kentucky aging and disability starting contact
organization: Kentucky Department for Aging and Independent Living
description: Statewide information and routing to regional aging and disability services.
next_step: Give your county and describe the daily-living need. Ask for local intake and appropriate assessment.
constraints: Military service is not required. Individual programs have separate eligibility.

name: Kentucky Homecare Program
organization: Kentucky Department for Aging and Independent Living
description: Assessment and support at home for eligible adults age 60+ at risk of institutional care; services may include personal care, meals, chores, repairs and respite.
next_step: Call your regional aging agency for screening, assessment and the services offered locally.
constraints: Functional or institutional-risk criteria apply. Some areas have waiting lists and services vary by area.

name: Kentucky Home and Community Based waiver
description: Medicaid waiver services may include personal assistance, respite and environmental or minor home adaptations.
next_step: Ask about financial eligibility, level-of-care assessment, enrollment and prior authorization for the proposed service.
constraints: For people age 65+ and/or with a physical disability who meet Medicaid and nursing-facility level-of-care requirements. The reviewed state page reports a waiting list; confirm current status.

name: Kentucky SHIP: Medicare counseling
organization: Kentucky Department for Aging and Independent Living
description: Free counseling on Medicare coverage, costs and consumer questions for beneficiaries, families and caregivers.
next_step: Call the SHIP hotline, choose menu option 2 and ask for a counselor.
constraints: SHIP does not sell insurance. Medicaid and other assistance require separate screening.

name: Kentucky long-term-care ombudsman
description: Resident-directed advocacy for concerns in nursing homes, personal care homes and family care homes.
next_step: Choose your county for the district contact, or use the state hotline. Explain the resident’s concerns and preferred follow-up.
constraints: For immediate danger, call 911. The ombudsman is an advocacy route, not emergency response.

name: KATS Network: equipment trials and loans
description: Assistive technology demonstrations and short-term equipment loans for Kentuckians of all ages and disabilities.
next_step: Ask for the regional assistive technology center, a suitable device trial and loan terms.
constraints: Inventory varies; nominal loan fees, late fees, shipping and return requirements may apply. Confirm terms with the lending center.

name: Kentucky assistive technology financing
description: KATLC works with the Appalachian Assistive Technology Loan Fund on loans for qualifying disability-related technology purchases.
next_step: Ask about eligibility, current loan terms, repayment requirements and whether the proposed equipment or ramp qualifies.
constraints: This is a loan requiring approval and repayment, not a grant.

name: Kentucky Protection and Advocacy
description: Disability rights information and advocacy under the state protection and advocacy system.
next_step: Describe the disability access or rights concern and ask about intake, priorities and next steps.
constraints: Representation depends on eligibility, agency priorities and capacity.

name: Kentucky vision loss: independent living services
description: Statewide individualized assessment and adaptive daily-living skills training for Kentuckians with vision impairments.
next_step: Ask about IL/OIB assessment, training, low-vision aids and the service appropriate to the person’s needs.
constraints: Confirm program-specific eligibility and available equipment.

name: Kentucky Relay
organization: Kentucky Commission on the Deaf and Hard of Hearing
description: Telephone communication assistance connecting relay users and voice callers.
next_step: Dial 711 and ask about the relay method that meets your communication needs.
constraints: Relay is a communication service; it does not provide hearing-aid funding.

name: Kentucky hearing support and specialized phones
organization: Kentucky Commission on the Deaf and Hard of Hearing
description: Information, referral and advocacy for hearing-related needs, plus Telecommunications Access Program equipment applications.
next_step: Ask about communication access and TAP equipment. Videophone users may call 502-416-0607.
constraints: The published TAP route requires at least one year of Kentucky residence and a qualifying communication disability. Confirm current eligibility. Hearing-aid referrals do not guarantee funding.

name: Kentucky caregiver support
organization: Kentucky Department for Aging and Independent Living
description: Regional access to family caregiver information, counseling, training and respite; separate support exists for qualifying grandparent caregivers.
next_step: Call the regional aging agency and identify the person cared for. Ask which caregiver program applies.
constraints: National Family Caregiver support includes eligible caregivers of people age 60+ or with Alzheimer’s/related disorders. Kentucky Family Caregiver is a separate grandparent program with its own household and financial rules. Availability varies.

name: Kentucky Hart-Supported Living
organization: Kentucky Department for Aging and Independent Living
description: Individualized grants can help Kentuckians with disabilities live in their chosen homes and communities.
next_step: Choose your county for the regional coordinator. Ask about eligible supports, application timing, funding review and written approval.
constraints: The program has living-arrangement exclusions and a separate application and funding process. A referral does not establish grant eligibility or available funding.

name: RampUp! KY: temporary portable ramp loans
description: Portable ramp loans for temporary access needs, subject to available sizes and stock.
next_step: Ask about a suitable ramp and the application, pickup, return and safe installation requirements.
constraints: Loans last up to six months and stock is limited. RampUp! KY does not build ramps. Applicants arrange pickup, return, setup and installation; suitability is not guaranteed.
